## Instructions

1. Boil chicken with onion 1 1/2 hours, skimming. [+]
2. Remove chicken, bone it and cut the meat.
3. Strain broth, add vegetables, cook 20 minutes.
4. Add noodles and meat; cook 10 minutes.
5. Season.
